{{short description|Norwegian American mathematician}}
'''Ivar Stakgold''' (December 13, 1925 – May 29, 2018)<ref name=obit>{{cite news |author=<!--Staff writer(s); no by-line.--> |title= Obituary: Ivar Stakgold|url= http://www.legacy.com/obituaries/sandiegouniontribune/obituary.aspx?n=ivar-stakgold&pid=189267950&fhid=9473|work= The San Diego Union Tribune |location= San Diego, California|date= 12 June 2018|access-date= 14 June 2018}}</ref> was a [[Norwegians|Norwegian]]-born American academic mathematician and [[Contract bridge|bridge]] player from [[Newark, Delaware]].<ref name=OEB>{{OEB|5|746}}</ref> As the sole author of two books he specialized in [[boundary value problem]]s ([[LCSH]]).<ref name=LCC1/><ref name=LCC2/>

== Life==

Stakgold was born in [[Oslo, Norway]] to parents with Russian-Jewish heritage.<ref>{{cite web| url = https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/sandiegouniontribune/name/ivar-stakgold-obituary?id=8058266| title = Ivar Stakgold Obituary (1925 - 2018) - San Diego, Ca, CA - San Diego Union-Tribune| website = [[Legacy.com]]}}</ref><!--source is Ext link LCCN--><ref>{{cite book|title=American Men & Women of Science: Q-S|date=2003|publisher=Thomson Gale|isbn=0787665290|page=943}}</ref> He studied applied mathematics at Harvard University and earned the Ph.D. in 1949 with a dissertation, ''The Cauchy Relations In A Molecular Theory of Elasticity'', under [[Léon Brillouin|Léon Nicolas Brillouin]].<ref name=MGP/> He was professor emeritus of mathematical sciences at the [[University of Delaware]] and a researcher at the [[University of California, San Diego]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://ccom.ucsd.edu/people/faculty.php|title=CCoM People Faculty|work=Center for Computational Mathematics|publisher=University of California, San Diego|access-date=2024-06-19}}</ref> He was a former president of the [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics]] (SIAM).<ref name=LCC1>[http://catdir.loc.gov/catdir/enhancements/fy0607/78027259-b.html "Contributor biographical information for Green's functions and boundary value problems / Ivar Stakgold"]. [[Library of Congress]]. [1998?]. Retrieved 2014-11-04. <br />&nbsp;With more information linked.</ref>

== Books ==
<!-- not Publications or Works because i presume numerous academic articles by Stakgold and this is now limited to books -- namely 2014-11-04, LC Online Catalog browse from Ext link below finds 8 catalog records for editions of these 5 titles -P64 --> <!--2014-11-04, all mathematics -->

=== By Stakgold ===
* ''Boundary Value Problems of Mathematical Physics'', 2 vols. (Macmillan, 1967), Macmillan series in advanced mathematics and theoretical physics, {{LCCN|67010304}}; reprint 2000, SIAM Classics in applied mathematics, no. 29<ref name=LCC2>[http://catdir.loc.gov/catdir/enhancements/fy0726/99088661-d.html "Publisher description for Boundary value problems of mathematical physics / Ivar Stakgold"]. Library of Congress. [2000]. Retrieved 2014-11-04. <br />&nbsp;With more information linked.</ref>
* ''Nonlinear Problems in the Physical Sciences and Biology: proceedings of a Battelle Summer Institute, Seattle, July 3–28, 1972'', eds. Stakgold and others ([[Springer-Verlag]], 1973), {{LCCN|73078428}}  <!-- sponsor [[Battelle Memorial Institute]]? -->
* ''Green's Functions and Boundary Value Problems'' (Wiley, 1979); 2nd ed. 1998; [https://books.google.com/books/about/Green_s_Functions_and_Boundary_Value_Pro.html?id=8OeoISCW6qUC 3rd ed. 2011], Stakgold and Michael J. Holst<ref name=LCC1/>
* ''Analytical and Computational Methods in Scattering and Applied Mathematics'', eds. Fadil Santosa and Stakgold ([[Chapman & Hall]]/CRC, 2000) – "A volume to the memory of [[Ralph E. Kleinman|Ralph Ellis Kleinman]]", {{LCCN|99087683}}  <!-- Chapman & Hall/CRC research notes in mathematics series, no. 417 -->

=== Other ===
* ''Nonlinear Problems in Applied Mathematics: in honor of Ivar Stakgold on his 70th birthday'', eds.  <!--Tom-->T.S. Angell and others (Philadelphia:SIAM, 1996), {{LCCN|96112982}}
